properties.title: Nigeria: single-signal dip, 48.1% (merit-nt)
properties.summary: Nigeria (NG): 48.1% connectivity drop (BGP no drop, active probing -0.1%, darknet -48.1%) over 5 h, against the same hours of the 7 days before. z-score -2.96 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Access Now's STOP sheet lists 2 shutdowns here in 2025 (stated causes: conflict), the latest starting 2025-05-31; history only, not evidence about this outage.

properties.title: US Virgin Islands: single-signal dip, 46.2% (ping-slash24)
properties.summary: US Virgin Islands (VI): 46.2% connectivity drop (BGP -2.8%, active probing -46.2%) over 6 h 20 min, against the same hours of the 7 days before. darknet left out: its baseline median, 0.12, is under the floor of 20. z-score -7.95 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Access Now's STOP sheet lists no shutdown in this country in 2025; context only, not evidence about this outage.
